headlines.title: Lindsay Clancy murder case ends in mistrial
headlines.description: The mistrial came after an extraordinary final day in which the defense made a last-ditch appeal to Massachusetts’ top court over a juror it said was blocking a not guilty verdict. NBC News’ Emilie Ikeda reports.

headlines.title: Will Lindsay Clancy be retried? How and when it could happen
headlines.description: Judge William Sullivan declared a mistrial Friday after the jury weighing the fate of Lindsay Clancy failed for the third time to reach a verdict in the case. NBC News' Laura Jarrett and Misty Marris discuss when the Massachusetts mother could face another trial.

headlines.title: Judge again blocks Trump’s effort to restrict mail voting as ballots start going out
headlines.description: The move comes as the Trump administration is appealing a related order to the Supreme Court.

headlines.title: Trump calls war with Iran ‘small potatoes’ for U.S.
headlines.description: President Trump called the conflict with Iran ‘small potatoes,’ adding the U.S. was now protecting oil tankers from Iranian attacks in the Strait of Hormuz. NBC News’ Gabe Gutierrez reports.

headlines.title: Rogue OpenAI agents hijacked German website, making more than 15,000 edits
headlines.description: A swarm of rogue OpenAI agents hijacked a German website back in May, making more than 15,000 edits and turning the site into a message board. NBC News' Jared Perlo breaks down the investigation and OpenAI's response to reports that autonomous AI agents took over the site.

headlines.title: Texas Attorney General investigates military healthcare contractor TriWest
headlines.description: Following a report for the series “The Cost of Denial,” Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton announced an investigation into the company at the center of the Nightly News story. NBC News’ Erin McLaughlin reports.

headlines.title: Fake NFL player arrested for scamming women out of a million dollars
headlines.description: An alleged fraud scheme involving a fake NFL player has set the sports world abuzz. The federal government says the victims were collectively bilked out of more than a million dollars. Daejon Love is accused of pretending to be a professional football player to lure women to invest money with him. NBC News correspondent Sam Brock has the details.

headlines.title: Baby girl is one of two deaths in Pennsylvania measles outbreak, coroner said
headlines.description: A 6-week-old baby girl is one of two people with measles who died in Pennsylvania, the Lancaster County coroner said Friday, as the nation’s measles tally hit a new 35-year record of 3,134 cases.

headlines.title: I found 150+ Labor Day sales that are actually worth shopping — deals are up to 75% off
headlines.description: Labor Day 2026 is on Sept. 7, but deals are already here. Get up to 75% off Amazon, Home Depot, Wayfair, Lowe’s and REI, plus learn expert-approved savings tips.

headlines.title: Halloween Chocolatey Eyeballs Candy Recalled Over Allergy Risks
headlines.description: New Jersey candy company Little Temptations has recalled their popular “chocolatey eyeballs” because of undeclared milk allergens. The candy is sold at major retailers including Marshalls, TJ Maxx, and Home Goods in 13 states.

headlines.title: Illinois mother charged with murder after killing 2-year-old, attempting to harm herself
headlines.description: A suburban Illinois mother, who had become interested in the Lindsay Clancy case, has been charged with murder after she allegedly killed her 2-year-old son then attempted to harm herself, according to police and court records.
